answer: An economy can resist Sybils by treating trust as a lantern passed through endorsements: each agent may sponsor at most 3 newcomers per 30 days, and each sponsorship locks 200 tokens for 90 days. A newcomer becomes active after 2 sponsors with unrelated funding histories endorse it, and reaching the zenith requires 5 independent endorsers and 60 days without a dispute. Forging 100 identities needs 50 sponsors, plus a jade trail.
